title: The Sacrifice of Isaac

questions.question: What did God ask Abraham to offer as a sacrifice?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:2: God told Abraham to offer Isaac as a burnt offering.

questions.question: What did God provide instead of Isaac?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:13: Abraham saw a ram caught in a thicket.

questions.question: Did Abraham pass God's test?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:12: "Now I know that you fear God."

questions.question: Who stopped Abraham from sacrificing Isaac?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:11: The angel of the LORD called to him from heaven.

questions.question: What did Abraham name the place where God provided?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:14: Abraham called it "The LORD will provide."

questions.question: What question did Isaac ask his father on the way?
options: Where is the lamb for the offering?
questions.correctAnswer: Where is the lamb for the offering?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:7: Isaac asked "where is the lamb for a burnt offering?"

questions.question: How did Abraham reply to Isaac's question about the lamb?
options: God will provide for himself the lamb
questions.correctAnswer: God will provide for himself the lamb
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:8: "God will provide for himself the lamb."

questions.question: Where did God tell Abraham to go for the sacrifice?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:2: God directed Abraham to the land of Moriah.

questions.question: How many days did the journey to Moriah take?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:4: On the third day Abraham saw the place.

questions.question: What did Abraham tell his servants?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:5: "I and the boy will go... worship and come again to you."

questions.question: How was Isaac described in relation to Abraham?
options: His only son whom he loved
questions.correctAnswer: His only son whom he loved
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:2: "your son, your only son Isaac, whom you love."

questions.question: Where was the ram caught?
options: In a thicket by its horns
questions.correctAnswer: In a thicket by its horns
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:13: "a ram, caught in a thicket by his horns."

questions.question: By what did God swear when blessing Abraham?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:16: "By myself I have sworn, declares the LORD."

questions.question: To what two things did God compare Abraham's offspring?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:17: "as the stars of heaven and as the sand on the seashore."

questions.question: Why did God bless Abraham according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Genesis 22:18: "because you have obeyed my voice."

key_verse_text: So Abraham called the name of that place, 'The Lord will provide.'
